adjudication.rationale: The diff adds Admin::EmbeddableHostsController with nontrivial CRUD logic (create/update/destroy and save_host param handling/defaulting) but the only spec added is a subclass assertion (spec/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller_spec.rb). So CRUD behavior, defaulting category_id to uncategorized, and error rendering paths are indeed untested. The finding’s cited crash risks are also grounded in the new code: save_host dereferences params[:embeddable_host][:host] and [:category_id] without guarding against params[:embeddable_host] being nil, and update/destroy can get a nil host from .where(...).first and then call save_host(nil) or host.destroy, leading to NoMethodError—none of which has coverage.
